broadcast_tensor_to_gpus: broadcast a tensor across multiple GPU devices for distributed data parallel training
broadcast_coalesced_tensors: broadcast a sequence of tensors to multiple GPUs using a coalesced buffer for efficiency
reduce_add_tensors_gpus: sum tensors from multiple GPUs into a single result tensor on a destination device
scatter_tensor_across_gpus: scatter a tensor into chunks across multiple GPUs along a specified dimension
gather_tensors_from_gpus: gather tensors from multiple GPU devices and concatenate them along a dimension
